name: Legs-Up-The-Wall Pose (Viparita Karani)
equipment: A yoga mat and a wall
instructions: Sit sideways next to a wall, then swing your legs up as you lower your back to the floor.
Scoot your hips as close to the wall as comfortable, letting your legs rest against it.
Rest your arms out to the sides, palms up, and breathe slowly and evenly.
